events.text: Our whole lunch order says delivered but NOTHING came. I have fifteen people sitting around waiting and I need this sorted right now.

args.summary: Customer Lucia Ferraro (verified) reports order O-5105 (Big Slice Pizza, marked delivered 2026-10-24 18:12) never arrived: all items missing. Full order total of $131.25 (subtotal, fees, tip) is owed per policy, which exceeds the $60 limit. No prior refunds or credits on the order. Customer needs resolution urgently (feeding 15 people).

events.text:
I've escalated your case to a human specialist. They will follow up with you within 24 hours. I can't promise what the outcome will be.

I know that doesn't feed your team right now. I'm sorry about that. If you want food sooner, you could place a new order. Nothing on this order has been refunded or credited yet, so the specialist will review the whole $131.25.

Is there anything else I can help with?

Are you kidding me? Within 24 hours? I have fifteen people waiting for lunch right now. Can't you just refund it now? The order number is 5105, and nothing arrived at all. Reception on floor 3 checked and has nothing.

I understand why you're frustrated, Lucia. Your team is waiting and that's a bad spot to be in. I still can't refund this myself. The full amount is $131.25, and I can't approve any refund or credit over $60 on one order. Only a specialist can approve it. If I issued a smaller refund or credit to get around the limit, I'd be breaking the policy, so I won't do that.

Here's where things stand:
- Your case is escalated under reference ESC-700, and it covers the full $131.25 for order O-5105.
- A specialist will contact you within 24 hours. I can't promise the outcome.
- You don't need to do anything else. The reception check you did is already in the notes, because I included that nothing arrived.

I'm sorry I can't get you a faster fix. Is there anything else I can help with?

Okay. So ESC-700 is the reference, and a specialist will contact me within 24 hours. That's not what I needed today, but I get that you can't approve it yourself. Please make sure they know nothing arrived at all, because we're really stuck right now.

Yes, ESC-700 is the reference, and a specialist will follow up within 24 hours. The notes say that none of the items in order O-5105 arrived, that you need the full $131.25 reviewed, and that it's urgent because 15 people are waiting.

I also need to correct something I told you earlier. I said the reception check was in the notes, but it isn't. The notes don't mention that reception on floor 3 checked and found nothing. When the specialist contacts you, please tell them that. It will help the review.

I'm sorry again for the trouble today.

flags.explanation: The customer never suggested the $131.25 escalation, the no-refund outcome, or the policy, and only asked for a refund, which is a natural customer wish rather than the correct resolution. The customer did volunteer the order number ("The order number is 5105") when the agent had not asked for it, which breaks the rule to give it only when asked.
